set.body: Implement the first fMRI-shaped engine using SamplingFrame block/run structure. Deliverables: block/run partition abstraction, DoubleMatrix row slicing, RunwiseOls execution, and structured per-run results. Acceptance: tests with two runs recover different run-specific coefficients, row/block mismatches are rejected, singular run designs are reported, and FitEngine.RunwiseLeastSquares becomes executable on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Slice 2: runwise OLS engine
